Pinterest

Your publication calendar, prepared English copy and batch tasks. Keep the images in your own OneDrive.

Prepared Pins & publication dates

Sign in to open your private Pinterest plan.

Scheduled means you marked the Pin as scheduled yourself. It does not prove that Pinterest has published it. Only batch tasks receive reminders; there is no separate email for every Pin.

Batch tasks & new-story follow-up

Open a task to mark a completed batch Done. New published stories get a Pinterest preparation task; completing a draft alone does not publish or schedule Pins.
